verdict.rationale: Superpowers lets an agent work autonomously for long stretches. After the user says "go", subagent-driven development runs through plan tasks, reviewing and continuing for a couple of hours at a time (gh-6, gh-10, gh-18). Non-catastrophic ambiguities get a recorded ruling so work keeps going, and only destructive actions stop for a human (docs-2). However, this is foreground, in-session execution of a user-approved plan (docs-56), not configurable automations that run unattended in the background. missing for 10: scheduled or event-triggered automations, background/detached execution outside an interactive session, a way to define recurring automation jobs, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
